name: Metric Tree
tagline: KPI dashboards that show what actually drives results
about: Metric Tree helps analysts and founders define the metrics that matter, design dashboards people actually read, write metric definitions everyone agrees on and narrate the weekly numbers.
persona: You are a pragmatic analytics lead: you prefer five metrics with owners to fifty without, define every metric precisely, and write commentary that leads with the change and its cause.

onboarding.title: Fewer metrics, better decisions
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us about the business so every metric fits.

tools.title: Build a metric tree
tools.subtitle: Goal → drivers → inputs
tools.prompt: Build a metric tree for '{goal}' owned by {team} in the profile's business. Kv (north-star metric, its definition, why it is the north star), a table 'Tree' (Level | Metric | Formula | Parent metric | Owner | Leading or lagging), bullets on the 3 input metrics with the most leverage, and a callout on vanity metrics to leave off.

tools.title: Design the dashboard
tools.subtitle: Tiles, charts, comparisons

inputs.label: Metrics to include
inputs.placeholder: MRR, net new MRR, churn %, CAC, activation rate, NPS

tools.prompt: Design a {audience} dashboard for {metrics} in the profile's tool and review cadence. Table 'Layout' (Position | Metric | Visual (big number / line / bar / table) | Comparison (vs target / prior period) | Filter), steps to build the top row in that tool, a checklist of dashboard hygiene (date-range control, definitions link, last-refreshed stamp, colour rules), and a callout on what to cut to keep it on one screen.

tools.title: Define a metric
tools.subtitle: A definition everyone agrees on

inputs.label: How it's used today
inputs.placeholder: product counts it differently from marketing

tools.prompt: Write a metric definition for '{metric}' given: {context}. Kv (definition, formula, numerator, denominator, inclusions, exclusions, time window, grain, source table, owner, refresh), a table 'Edge cases' (Case | Counted? | Why), a quote with the one-sentence definition for the dashboard tooltip, and a callout on how the definition will shift historical numbers.

tools.title: Narrate this period
tools.subtitle: Numbers → commentary

inputs.label: What happened
inputs.placeholder: price rise on the 1st, a sales rep left

tools.prompt: Write the commentary for {numbers} given the context: {context}, matching the profile's review cadence. Text with a 3-sentence headline summary leading with the biggest change and its cause, a table 'Movements' (Metric | Value | Change | Driver | Action), bullets of 3–5 questions to investigate before the next review, and a callout on any number that looks like a data issue rather than a real change.

tools.title: Set alert thresholds
tools.subtitle: Know when a metric needs attention
tools.prompt: Propose alert thresholds for {metric} using the history: {history}. Kv (normal range, warning threshold, critical threshold, method used, expected false alarms per month), a table 'Alert rules' (Rule | Condition | Who is notified | First action), bullets on seasonality and weekday effects to account for, and a callout on alert fatigue.
